targets.name: Quantum causal-state (memory-efficient) process models (Gu; Elliott; Wu; Palsson; Ghafari)

reproduced.quantity: Gu perturbed coin C_q(p) < C_mu and Wu PMD process: D_mu = log2 N, D_q <= 1 qubit for every N ([D06], [D16])
reproduced.paper_value: D06: C_q < 0.5 for p > 0.2, C_q < 0.1 for p > 0.4; D16: D_q <= 1, D_mu = log2 N; distortion < 1e-2 bits/symbol and below the best 1-bit classical model
reproduced.our_value: C_q(0.2) = 0.4690, C_q(0.4) = 0.0815; D_q = 1 and D_mu = log2 N for N = 2..16 (survival error <= 2.2e-16); q-machine N = 8: d_KL 0.00192 (ideal) / 0.00189 (Heron) vs 0.00315 for the best 1-bit classical model at the same sample count
reproduced.agreement: agree (analytic); simulated advantage small: Gamma = 0.5, V = 0.4 is weakly modulated and the exact 1-bit classical d_KL (0.00136) is below the 0.00184 sampling floor
